title: Sea-Watch says its Italian spokesperson was spied on with spyware on her phone
date_note: Il Post gives only its publication day (25 November) for the NGO's disclosure; the infection it describes dates to 2021.
geo_basis: Italy, where Il Post says the spokesperson works; Il Post describes Sea-Watch as a German NGO
summary: Il Post reports that the NGO Sea-Watch says its Italian spokesperson, Giorgia Linardi, was spied on through spyware on her phone. According to Il Post, two independent forensic reports confirm a first infection at the end of May 2021 and monitoring for at least two months. Il Post says Sea-Watch filed a complaint against unknown persons in Rome and asked to join an existing Paragon spyware investigation. It does not say who was behind it.
plain: Sea-Watch says its Italian spokesperson's phone was infected with spyware in 2021. Il Post reports two forensic reports back this, and that the person responsible is not named.
exec: Sea-Watch says its Italian spokesperson was monitored through spyware, per two forensic reports as relayed by Il Post; no culprit is named.

validation.note: One publisher read (Il Post); zazoom.it only repeats the headline. Sea-Watch's statement and the forensic reports are relayed, not read; no authority has confirmed.

review.note: Compared title, summary, forensic reports, 2021 infection, Rome complaint and no culprit named against Il Post; single_source fits
